quality_codes.A: Highest quality per source CSV documentation
quality_codes.D: Poorly determined epicentre or Mw, as documented by the supplement

schema.time_encoding: Offset-free source origin dates interpreted as UTC. The output retains hundredths of a second and adds the ISO 8601 UTC suffix Z.
schema.retained_events: Inclusive UTC calendar years 1918–2022 and published Mw >= 7. Includes direct and proxy Mw at their published precision. Blank and unparseable Mw are counted separately and excluded from threshold totals. Source lines use one-based numbering. The original row text excludes the terminating newline.
schema.annual_values: All arrays align with annual.years and include zero-count years.

identity_checks.combined_series_rule: Sum separate counts after checking all source IDs are unique within each file and disjoint across files. Exact time/latitude/longitude triples are also unique within and disjoint across files.
